method: the exporter was run in 4 independent OS processes and the outputs compared byte for byte
root_cause: upstream builds some `must` alternative lists out of sets (address_variants, company_variants); CPython randomises string hashing per process, so set iteration order — and therefore the order of the alternatives — differed between runs
fix: the exporter pins PYTHONHASHSEED=0 by re-executing itself once before importing anything
why_this_is_safe: upstream scores these with check_answer(), which uses any() over the alternatives, so their order carries no meaning; only the failure message names alts[0]
